title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to: A. AWARD a three-year firm fixed price contract, Contract No. OP138405000 to Balfour Beatty Infrastructure, Inc.,…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0702, Contract]
[OPERATIONS, SAFETY, AND CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (5-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to:

A.	AWARD a three-year firm fixed price contract, Contract No. OP138405000 to Balfour Beatty Infrastructure, Inc., the lowest responsive and responsible bidder for the Metro C/K Line Mainline Fastener Replacement Project in the amount of $13,683,652, subject to the resolution of any properly submitted protest(s), if any; and

B.	INCREASE the Life of Project Budget (LOP) for Project 205695 - Metro C/K Line Mainline Fastener Replacement by $4,065,494, increasing the LOP from $17,100,000 to $21,165,494.
summary: Metro would award Balfour Beatty Infrastructure a three-year, $13.7 million contract to replace fasteners on the C/K Line mainline, and raise the project's budget by $4.1 million to $21.2 million.
